title: Clarinet parts on High Society and Picou
summary: Solos were tune-specific parts such as the clarinet part in High Society, which Barnes says is strangled today. Picou praised his playing and sat in at a party.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: Did you ever take solos by yourself without him playing?

That just made me disgusted as well. I used to play that time. I started as good as Piqui. Piqui was great about me playing it. Up until he died, I played a part. I played a part up there at St. Philip and Ridley. They had a big party in there, and they got me to play credit, and Piqui was a guest. So he'd come and see my part, play my number. That was him. He'd come up, he'd sit in, and that's all that man play out of the time. That's the way you ought to play.
